title: Home & Rooms (家与房间)
description: Talk about your home in Mandarin: rooms and furniture, saying what there is with 有 (yǒu), saying where things are with 在 (zài), and location words like 上面 and 旁边.

notes.heading: 📌 Rooms of the House (房间)
notes.body:
Every home has different rooms, and each one has its own name in Chinese. Notice that many room words end in 房 (fáng) or 室 (shì), both meaning "room".

| Chinese | Pinyin | English |
|---|---|---|
| 客厅 | kètīng | living room |
| 卧室 | wòshì | bedroom |
| 厨房 | chúfáng | kitchen |
| 浴室 | yùshì | bathroom |
| 餐厅 | cāntīng | dining room |
| 书房 | shūfáng | study (room) |
| 厕所 | cèsuǒ | toilet |

Example: 我家有三个卧室。 (Wǒ jiā yǒu sān ge wòshì.) — My home has three bedrooms.

notes.heading: 📌 Furniture (家具)
notes.body:
Furniture is 家具 (jiājù). Learn these common items so you can say what is in each room:

| Chinese | Pinyin | English |
|---|---|---|
| 桌子 | zhuōzi | table / desk |
| 椅子 | yǐzi | chair |
| 床 | chuáng | bed |
| 沙发 | shāfā | sofa |
| 书架 | shūjià | bookshelf |
| 衣柜 | yīguì | wardrobe |
| 电视 | diànshì | television |

沙发 (shāfā) is a sound-loan from the English word "sofa" — listen for it!

Example: 卧室里有一张床。 (Wòshì li yǒu yì zhāng chuáng.) — In the bedroom there is a bed.

notes.heading: 🔑 Saying Something Exists: 有 (yǒu)
notes.body:
有 (yǒu) means "to have" and also "there is / there are".

Pattern: Place + 有 + thing.

- 客厅里有一个沙发。 (Kètīng li yǒu yí ge shāfā.) — There is a sofa in the living room.
- 我家有四个房间。 (Wǒ jiā yǒu sì ge fángjiān.) — My home has four rooms.

⚠️ Common mistake: the negative is 没有 (méiyǒu), never 不有. So "my home does not have a study" is 我家没有书房。

To ask a question, add 吗 (ma): 你家有浴室吗? (Nǐ jiā yǒu yùshì ma?) — Does your home have a bathroom?

notes.heading: 🔑 Saying Where Things Are: 在 (zài)
notes.body:
在 (zài) means "to be at / in / on" a place. It tells you WHERE someone or something is.

Pattern: Thing + 在 + place.

- 我在客厅。 (Wǒ zài kètīng.) — I am in the living room.
- 书在桌子上。 (Shū zài zhuōzi shàng.) — The book is on the table.

⚠️ Common mistake: do not use 是 (shì) for location. 书是桌子上 is wrong — it must be 书在桌子上.

The negative is 不在 (bú zài): 他不在家。 (Tā bú zài jiā.) — He is not at home.

notes.heading: 📌 Location Words (方位词)
notes.body:
To say exactly where something is, put the location word after the reference object, often with 的 (de) before it.

| Chinese | Pinyin | English |
|---|---|---|
| 上面 | shàngmiàn | on top of / above |
| 下面 | xiàmiàn | under / below |
| 旁边 | pángbiān | next to / beside |
| 前面 | qiánmiàn | in front of |
| 后面 | hòumiàn | behind |
| 中间 | zhōngjiān | in the middle (of) |
| 里面 | lǐmiàn | inside |

Pattern: A 在 B (的) + location word.

- 猫在椅子下面。 (Māo zài yǐzi xiàmiàn.) — The cat is under the chair.
- 书架在桌子旁边。 (Shūjià zài zhuōzi pángbiān.) — The bookshelf is next to the table.
- 沙发在桌子和椅子中间。 (Shāfā zài zhuōzi hé yǐzi zhōngjiān.) — The sofa is between the table and the chair.

notes.heading: 🔑 Counting Rooms: 间 (jiān)
notes.body:
Chinese uses a measure word between a number and a noun. For rooms, the measure word is 间 (jiān).

- 一间卧室 (yì jiān wòshì) — one bedroom
- 两间浴室 (liǎng jiān yùshì) — two bathrooms
- 三间房间 (sān jiān fángjiān) — three rooms

Remember: "two" before a measure word is 两 (liǎng), not 二 (èr).

Example: 我家有两间卧室和一间书房。 (Wǒ jiā yǒu liǎng jiān wòshì hé yì jiān shūfáng.) — My home has two bedrooms and one study.

The all-purpose measure word 个 (ge) is used for many other things, but rooms take 间.

notes.heading: 💡 Describing Your Home
notes.body:
Now put it all together to describe your home. Useful adjectives:

| Chinese | Pinyin | English |
|---|---|---|
| 大 | dà | big |
| 小 | xiǎo | small |
| 干净 | gānjìng | clean |
| 舒服 | shūfu | comfortable |

Model paragraph:

我家有三间房间：一个客厅、一个厨房和一个卧室。我的房间不大，但是很干净。客厅里有一个沙发和一台电视。沙发在电视前面。我很喜欢我的家。

(Wǒ jiā yǒu sān jiān fángjiān: yí ge kètīng, yí ge chúfáng hé yí ge wòshì. Wǒ de fángjiān bú dà, dànshì hěn gānjìng. Kètīng li yǒu yí ge shāfā hé yì tái diànshì. Shāfā zài diànshì qiánmiàn. Wǒ hěn xǐhuan wǒ de jiā.)

"My home has three rooms: a living room, a kitchen and a bedroom. My room is not big, but it is very clean. In the living room there is a sofa and a TV. The sofa is in front of the TV. I really like my home."

✅ Check: can you say how many rooms your home has, and where two pieces of furniture are?

flashcards.example: 我们一家人在客厅看电视。 — Our whole family watches TV in the living room.
我的卧室很小。 — My bedroom is very small.
妈妈在厨房做饭。 — Mum is cooking in the kitchen.
你家有几间浴室? — How many bathrooms does your home have?
客厅里有一个大沙发。 — There is a big sofa in the living room.
书架上有很多书。 — There are many books on the bookshelf.

flashcards.definition: to have; there is / there are
flashcards.example: 我家有三个房间。 — My home has three rooms.

flashcards.definition: to be at / in / on (a place)
flashcards.example: 书在桌子上。 — The book is on the table.
桌子上面有一本书。 — There is a book on top of the table.
椅子在桌子旁边。 — The chair is next to the table.
我家有两间卧室。 — My home has two bedrooms.
我的房间很干净。 — My room is very clean.

questions.explanation: 卧室 (wòshì) means bedroom — 卧 relates to lying down, which is what you do there to sleep.

questions.stem: Which room is the 厨房 (chúfáng)?
questions.explanation: 厨房 (chúfáng) is the kitchen, the room where food is cooked. The dining room is 餐厅 (cāntīng).

questions.stem: Which sentence means "There is a sofa in the living room"?
questions.explanation: 有 (yǒu) expresses existence with the pattern place + 有 + thing: 客厅里 (in the living room) 有 (there is) 沙发 (a sofa).

questions.stem: 桌子上面有一本书。 What does this sentence mean?
choices: There is a book under the table.
There is a book on top of the table.
The book is next to the table.
The table is on top of the book.
questions.explanation: 上面 (shàngmiàn) means on top of, so 桌子上面有一本书 says there is a book on the table. Under would be 下面 (xiàmiàn).

questions.stem: 沙发 (shāfā) is which piece of furniture?
questions.explanation: 沙发 (shāfā) means sofa — it is a sound-loan word that sounds like the English word "sofa".

questions.stem: Fill in the gap: 我家有三___卧室。 (My home has three bedrooms.)
questions.explanation: Rooms are counted with the measure word 间 (jiān): 三间卧室 means three bedrooms. 张 is for flat objects and 支 for pens.

questions.stem: How do you say "The cat is under the chair" in Chinese?
questions.explanation: The pattern is thing + 在 + object + location word: 猫 (cat) 在 (is) 椅子下面 (under the chair). 上面 would mean on top, and 有 cannot replace 在 for location.

questions.stem: Which of these sentences is correct Chinese?
questions.explanation: The subject comes first: 我家 (my home) + 有 (has) + 三个卧室 (three bedrooms). Chinese does not put 在 at the start like the English "in my home there are...".

questions.stem: 书架在桌子旁边。 What does this mean?
choices: The bookshelf is behind the table.
The table is next to the bookshelf.
The bookshelf is next to the table.
The bookshelf is in front of the table.
questions.explanation: 旁边 (pángbiān) means next to, and the thing before 在 is the one being located: the bookshelf is next to the table.

questions.stem: What does the verb 有 (yǒu) mean?
choices: to have; there is / there are
questions.explanation: 有 (yǒu) means to have, and it is also used for "there is / there are", as in 我家有三个房间 — my home has three rooms.

questions.stem: How do you ask "Does your home have a bathroom?"
questions.explanation: Use 有 (have) plus the question particle 吗: 你家有浴室吗? Using 在 would ask where something is, and the negative of 有 is 没, never 不.

questions.stem: What is the correct negative of 我家有书房。 (My home has a study.)?
questions.explanation: The negative of 有 is always 没有 (méiyǒu), never 不有: 我家没有书房 means my home does not have a study.

questions.stem: 沙发在桌子和椅子中间。 What does this sentence mean?
choices: The sofa is between the table and the chair.
The sofa is in front of the table and the chair.
The table and the chair are on the sofa.
The sofa is next to the table, behind the chair.
questions.explanation: 中间 (zhōngjiān) means in the middle: A 在 B 和 C 中间 means A is between B and C — here the sofa sits between the table and the chair.
干净 (gānjìng) means clean, as in 我的房间很干净 — my room is very clean. Comfortable is 舒服 (shūfu).

questions.stem: 电视在沙发前面。 What does this mean?
choices: The TV is behind the sofa.
The TV is in front of the sofa.
The sofa is in front of the TV.
The TV is next to the sofa.
questions.explanation: 前面 (qiánmiàn) means in front of, and 电视 comes before 在, so the TV is the thing being located: the TV is in front of the sofa.
